travel.rubber_tread_housing: static moulded shell; optional controller track FX, no invented tread deformation

rules: Reset all nodes to rest TRS before playing a clip. Each key specifies complete absolute local TRS.
AimYaw and Fire_Recoil can layer because they target separate pivots; Fire_Recoil socket inherits turret yaw.
Toy_Disabled cancels Travel and holds final harmless pose.
Each wheel interval is 45 degrees so quaternion SLERP preserves a complete rotation.
GroundShadow is a socket/footprint contract, not a rendered stage.
